mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte imbalances; amikacin is nephrotoxic and ototoxic, while risedronate requires careful renal dosing and can impair calcium/phosphate metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimicrobial if possible; assess baseline hearing function if prolonged amikacin therapy is necessary.
